title: PromptGenome
description: Evolvable prompt artifact produced by the promptsarchitekt skill. Inspired by MIF (Memory Interchange Format) three-tier ontology and soul.md identity-as-language patterns. Each genome represents a distilled, scored, and persisted prompt that compounds knowledge across sessions. Specific enough to be wrong.

genome_id.description: ULID-based unique identifier (sortable by creation time)

generation.description: Evolution generation counter. 0 = seed genome from cold start

memory_type.description: MIF-inspired three-tier ontology. semantic = facts about what works, episodic = evolution events, procedural = distillation rules and patterns

conformance_level.description: MIF conformance level. L1: basic (text+scores). L2: +relationships+lineage. L3: +decay+dual-format+citations

parent_id.description: genome_id of the parent genome. null for generation 0 (seed)

prompt_text.description: The actual prompt text. Target <500 tokens (~2000 chars). Density over verbosity.

target_context.description: What type of prompt this genome optimizes

hypothesis.description: Why this variant should outperform alternatives (from DISTILL phase)

specificity.description: Named entities, concrete instructions vs vague generalities. Guards against VERBOSITY_INFLATION.

constraint_clarity.description: Explicit boundaries (MUST/NEVER/ALWAYS), unambiguous scope. Guards against PREMATURE_COMMITMENT.

failure_resistance.description: Alignment with coherence-monitor signals. Guards against CONSERVATIVE_COLLAPSE.

memory_density.description: Knowledge-per-token ratio. No filler, no redundancy. Guards against Context Rot.

composability.description: Can chain with other skills, modular, valid references. Guards against isolation.

confidence.description: Judge-assigned confidence. Decays exponentially per MIF model: strength = e^(-t/halfLife). Reinforced on retrieval (+0.05, capped at 1.0). Pruned below 0.2.

temporal.description: MIF bi-temporal model: transaction time (when recorded) + valid time (when applicable)

half_life.description: ISO 8601 duration for exponential decay. P7D=short-term, P30D=default, P90D=permanent knowledge

relationships.description: MIF-inspired typed relationships to other genomes and entities

target_id.description: ID of the related genome or entity

tensions.description: soul.md-inspired: explicit contradictions and tensions this genome contains. Real effectiveness has inconsistencies — capture them as authenticity markers.

judge_rationale.description: Written rationale from the Judge (Opus) explaining the selection

vulnerabilities.description: Unmitigated vulnerabilities flagged by the Critic

anti_patterns_mitigated.description: Coherence-monitor failure modes this genome actively guards against

skills_cross_linked.description: Skills this genome references or integrates with

lineage.description: Ordered list of ancestor genome_ids from generation 0 to parent

evolution_delta.description: Percentage improvement over historical average. >+5% = breakthrough, <-5% = regression

access_count.description: Times retrieved by BM25/LDAR. Each access reinforces confidence.
